## Compare two retained review copies

From `freight_packets`, run `python -m freightpkt.review_compare COPY_A.zip COPY_B.zip --out comparison.html` to create a new self-contained comparison of two existing per-load saved-review ZIPs. The report shows complete native evidence records with duplicate counts, both saved review histories, and exact source identities. A and B retain the supplied order; no current approval is inferred. Both inputs are validated before exclusive output creation, and existing files are never replaced. No review, packet-generation or payment action is taken. See [REVIEW_COMPARE.md](REVIEW_COMPARE.md) for the accepted format, full behavior and write-failure limits.

reviewed_contract: Exactly five uniquely named ZIP members; never extracted or embedded.
All four payload sizes/hashes, native top-level schemas/load and canonical evidence/review identities are checked.
Counter keys use canonical JSON strings, preserving full records and duplicate occurrences without Python loose numeric equality.
Saved views remain complete and are attributed to supplied A/B; recorded timestamps are not reordered or elevated to current approval.
Main reads and validates both copies and renders complete UTF-8 before Path.open('xb'); no mkdir, pointer, App or pipeline action.
Runtime imports only standard library and unchanged native handoff.review_version.
limits: Source read confirms exclusive creation order; this reviewer made no physical output attempt because the fixed 96 KiB floor saw zero available bytes.
Author's separate physical results are attributed and linked by exact readback, not relabeled independent execution.
No authenticated authorship, freshness, input locking, archive resource bound or actual graphical/printing acceptance.
